title: The Last Ember Again
author: Zephyrine Montrose
blurb: Paloma Ashgrove, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
